## What To Know

In the recent Morning Consult tracker, Trump's approval rating is 45.2 percent compared to a 51.9 percent disapproval rating, showing a net approval of roughly -7 percent. Compared to a weekly survey taken roughly a month ago by the pollster, his net approval has improved roughly 6 percent.
